courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「清水混凝土的性能目標與等級」與「樣板牆、比對基準與驗收距離」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Performance targets and surface categories" and "Mock-up, reference standard and viewing distance" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦讓結構混凝土一次成形即為完成面：模板分割、面板與脫模劑、配比一致性、澆置與樣板驗收；鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工則以把設計圖上的韌性剪力牆真正做出來：邊界構材圍束、續接、鋼筋擁擠下的澆置與驗收為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on making structural concrete its own finished surface at one casting: panel layout, facing and release agent, mix consistency, placing and mock-up acceptance; Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction centres on building the ductile shear wall the drawings describe: boundary confinement, splices, placing concrete through congested steel, and acceptance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「成形面等級」與「牆體側力分配」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鋼筋混凝土剪力牆施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「強度驗收、鑽心試驗與非破壞檢測」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Formed-surface category” and “Lateral force share between walls”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Reinforced-concrete shear-wall construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Strength acceptance, cores and non-destructive testing", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 清水混凝土模板與澆置
history.text: 路易斯．康設計的沙克研究所於 1962 年 6 月動工、同年 12 月開始澆置混凝土，1967 年完工，以含火山灰的暖色混凝土與規則的模板痕跡成為清水混凝土的經典，1991 年被指定為歷史地標。安藤忠雄的光之教會於 1989 年在大阪茨木完成，以規則的模板分割與繫桿孔和牆上的十字光縫聞名，1999 年增建主日學校。ACI 347.3R 在 2014 年初版印行，把成形混凝土表面分為 CSC1 至 CSC4 四級；ACI 301-20 第 6 節則規定契約指定時適用的建築混凝土要求。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Louis Kahn's Salk Institute broke ground in June 1962, began placing concrete that December and was completed in 1967; its warm-toned concrete containing volcanic ash and orderly form marks made it a classic of exposed concrete, and it was designated a historic landmark in 1991. Tadao Ando's Church of the Light was completed in Ibaraki, Osaka in 1989, known for its regular panel layout, tie holes and the cross-shaped slit of light in its wall, and a Sunday school was added in 1999. ACI 347.3R was first printed in 2014, dividing formed concrete surfaces into four categories, CSC1 to CSC4, while ACI 301-20 Section 6 sets architectural-concrete requirements that apply when the contract designates them. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
